description: ST. CLOUD (KNSI) — With diesel well over $6 a gallon at harvest time, Senator Aric Putnam is asking Governor Walz for relief for Minnesota farmers, through either a special session or an executive order. “We gotta do something to help out Minnesota farmers,” Putnam told KNSI. Read more
